summary: Sigmoid growth toward a carrying capacity K. Early growth approximates exponential; once the population approaches K, growth slows toward zero.

ranges.phrase: The fitted carrying capacity is K = {K_value}; the trajectory cannot exceed this asymptote without a regime change.
Slow intrinsic growth rate — the system takes many time units to approach K.
Moderate intrinsic growth — visible curvature in the observed window.
Fast intrinsic growth — the system reaches a high fraction of K within the observed window.
